crm_notes:
Summary: Large capital markets trading platform. Evaluating Redwood Private VPC for: chat assistants for traders, doc search over regulatory docs, and reranking for signals pipelines. Key requirements: SSO via Okta (SAML 2.0), SCIM for automated user/group provisioning, RBAC tied to SAML groups in control plane, and BYOK KMS integration (AWS KMS + optional HSM). Data residency: must keep all indexing and logs in us-east-1 and retained for 2 years; legal asked about seven-year retention for audit trails — clarifying need.

Security review items (from InfoSec call):
- Confirm private control plane architecture: customer-managed VPC endpoints, no public control plane access, restricted management IP CIDRs.
- RBAC: need role templates (admin, auditor, infra, app-read/app-write). Map Okta groups -> Redwood roles via SCIM attributes; prefer SCIM group sync for group membership.
- SAML details: want IdP-initiated + SP-initiated flows, attribute mappings for email, uid, roles; session timeout policies configurable.
- SCIM: provisioning with incremental sync; deprovision must delete access and optionally flag data ownership.
- KMS/BYOK: must support key import or external HSM reference; require key-rotation policy visibility and proof of CMEK enforcement for model cache and logs.
- Audit logging: forward to customer's Splunk and S3 archive; retention policy controls in Console; immutable logs for 2-7 years.
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink; egress IPs for model downloads and metrics ingestion must be static and provided in advance.

POC scope and success metrics:
- Complete SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning for 150 users and 12 groups.
- RBAC enforced for at least 4 role types in Console, with logged enforcement events forwarded to Splunk.
- End-to-end KMS encryption of model cache + KV cache; provide KMS audit evidence.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 120ms for small chat prompts in us-east-1 during 100 qps traffic profile.
- Cost target: unit-token cost within 15% of their internal baseline during the POC.

Quotes & feedback from stakeholders:
- "We cannot accept plaintext model caches outside our KMS control" — Head of Infosec.
- "If we can get SCIM group sync working reliably, onboarding will drop from days to hours" — Dir. Platform Eng.

Open items/risks:
- Legal wants a copy of SOC2/ISO attestation and an SLA addendum for Private deployments.
- Network team requires IP allowlist for control plane egress; need exact CIDR list and ports.
- Pricing ask: committed-capacity scenario vs. short pilot pricing. Finance to provide ARR target.

Next actions assigned:
- SE (Arjun) to deliver SAML/SCIM mapping template by 2026-03-03.
- AE (Maya) to push updated commercial term sheet (inc. BYOK premium) to Drive and legal.
- Eng (Redwood infra) to confirm static egress IPs and KMS integration feasibility by 2026-03-10.
